Security personnel pushed aide during CM's inspection, called 'human error'

During an inspection of the 'Nitish Setu' bridge, a security personnel pushed Nishant Kumar. The Special Security Group (SSG) later clarified that the incident was a 'human error' in protocol. The security personnel involved was identified as belonging to Samrat Chaudhary's security detail. A video of the incident went viral, prompting the SSG's statement.
